title: Did Basie drop sick sidemen? A rumor Humes rejects
summary: Dance relays stories that Basie let a sick Charlie Fowlkes go while he was in hospital. Humes had never heard it and doubts Basie would have done it himself.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
